Product.title: Product
Product.description: Motorcycle accessory product listed in the BN_STONE catalog.

name.description: Arabic product title displayed to shoppers.

description.description: Detailed Arabic product description and specifications.

imageUrl.description: Public HTTPS or root-relative image URL for the product.

published.description: Controls whether the product is visible on the public storefront.

createdBy.description: UID of the authenticated admin who created the product.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the product was last updated.

StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Publicly readable storefront configuration managed exclusively by the owner.

whatsappPhone.description: Optional international WhatsApp contact number (empty until configured by owner).

currency.description: Currency label shown next to product prices.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin record granting access to manage BN_STONE catalog.

email.description: Verified email address of the authorized admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/products/{productId}.description: Motorcycle accessory products; published items are readable by everyone, while all writes and hidden items are restricted to verified admins.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Storefront configuration document at /settings/store; publicly readable, writable only by verified admins.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Allowlist of authorized admin UIDs; readable only by the matching user or bootstrap owner, writable only by bootstrap owner.
